products.title: G's UP HOLES DOWN TEE | WHITE
products.body_html:
G'S UP HOLES DOWN TEE

A little loud. Completely unapologetic. The G's Up Holes Down Tee is for the ones who show up early, talk a little trash on the first tee, and back every word of it by the eighteenth.

Not for the range-day crowd or the clubhouse critics. This one's for the real ones: the regulars, the grinders, the friends who never miss a Sunday tee time. Wear it to the course, wear it to the bar after, and let the scorecard do the rest.

Features

  • Mid-weight 5.9 oz, 100% carded cotton
  • Tubular body with no side seams for a clean drape
  • Preshrunk to minimize shrinkage

Fit

  • Regular fit
  • True to size; size up for a more relaxed look

Fabric

  • Mid-weight, 5.9 oz
  • 20-singles yarn
  • 100% carded cotton (marles 15% viscose)

Construction

  • Neck ribbing
  • Tubular construction, no side seams
  • Shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Double needle hems
  • Preshrunk to minimize shrinkage

Care

  • Machine wash cold, inside out, with like colors
  • Do not bleach
  • Tumble dry low or hang dry to keep the print looking its best
  • Do not iron directly on the print; if needed, iron inside out on low heat

Built for Sundays.

products.title: FAIRWAY HAT | SMOKE
products.body_html:
THE FAIRWAY HAT

Made for early tee times and the long way home along the coast. The Fairway Hat is cut from lightweight recycled nylon with a soft, unstructured crown that sits easy and packs flat, finished with our script F in clean flat embroidery at the front.

Quick to dry and light enough to forget it's there, it moves from the first tee to the water's edge and back again. A quiet piece for those who keep the game simple.

Features

  • Script F in flat embroidery at front
  • Single seamless front panel
  • Lightweight, quick-dry recycled nylon
  • Unstructured mid-profile crown
  • Tonal under-peak lining
  • Plastic snapback closure

Fit

  • Mid profile with a relaxed, unstructured shape
  • Adjustable snapback, one size fits all

Fabric

  • Lightweight
  • 100% recycled nylon
  • Quick-dry finish

Construction

  • Unstructured snapback
  • Single panel at front
  • Flat embroidery embellishment
  • Quick-dry fabric
  • Plastic snapback
  • Tonal under-peak lining

Care

  • Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap
  • Hand wash cold if needed; do not machine wash
  • Air dry and reshape while damp
  • Do not bleach, tumble dry, or iron

Built for Sundays.

READ THE BREAK

Some breaks are easier to read than others.

Inspired by the subtle illusions of a tricky green, READ THE BREAK Golf Towel features a swirling graphic that plays with your eyes—just like a putt that looks straight until it isn't.

Crafted with a premium waffle weave to keep your clubs and golf balls clean, it delivers the perfect balance of performance and personality for every round.

Features

  • 18" × 18"
  • Premium microfiber construction
  • Premium waffle weave for superior groove cleaning
  • Soft, lightweight, and highly absorbent
  • Machine washable (air dry recommended)
  • Includes carabiner clip for easy bag attachment

Because reading the break isn't always as easy as it looks.

Built for Sundays.

products.title: PATRIOT SIGNATURE HAT
products.body_html:
THE SIGNATURE HAT

Clean lines. Lightweight construction. Built to move.

Crafted from water-resistant performance polyester with perforated side panels for enhanced breathability, The Signature Hat delivers all-day comfort with a refined finish. Complete with our bonded 52 Icon logo and signature script embroidery, it's built to perform on the course and look just as good everywhere else.

Features

  • Colorway: Red / White / Blue
  • Water-resistant performance fabric
  • Breathable perforated side panels
  • Five-panel construction
  • Curved brim
  • Bonded 52 Icon side logo
  • Adjustable snapback closure
  • One size fits most (OSFM)

Fit

  • One size fits most
  • Adjustable snapback closure

Care

  • Hand wash cold with mild detergent, or spot clean
  • Do not bleach, iron, or tumble dry
  • Air dry away from direct heat
  • Shape the brim by hand while damp

Built for Sundays.

products.title: THE COURSE TEE
products.body_html:
THE COURSE TEE

Built around the Icon 52, The Course Tee reimagines the number as a playable golf course, blending original artwork with everyday comfort.

Crafted from premium combed cotton, it's a clean graphic tee designed for those who appreciate the game on and off the course.

Features

  • 100% premium combed cotton
  • Midweight, breathable fabric
  • Classic crew neckline
  • Soft, durable feel
  • Screen-printed back artwork
  • Pre-shrunk for a consistent fit, wash after wash

Fit

  • Regular fit with a relaxed feel through the body and sleeves
  • True to size for everyday comfort

Care

  • Machine wash cold, inside out, with like colors
  • Do not bleach
  • Tumble dry low or hang dry to keep the print looking its best
  • Do not iron directly on the print; if needed, iron inside out on low heat

Built for Sundays.
